product_metadata.title: Deco 79 Metal Fan Sculpture, 15" x 8" x 18", Black
features: VINTAGE THEME: Vintage inspired designs draw inspiration from the past to create a warm and inviting space that is full of personality
MADE OF IRON: Durable yet lightweight piece is made of iron construction throughout
BLACK MATTE FINISH: Vintage inspired fan offers an tarnished matte black finish structure and base
FEATURES ROUND SCULPTURE: Features a vintage style decorative electric fan complete with an old five-blade fan, distressed round metal grill cage, vintage riveting work and an old concept round base
CONVENIENTLY SIZED: This item measures 15L x 8W x 18H inches, and weighs 2.65 lbs
description: Use this antique table fan as an accent centerpiece in your industrial-inspired space displayed near other metal decor, exposed brick, and metal piping to bring bold vintage industrial charm to the table. Designed with felt or rubber stoppers at the base that prevent scratching furniture and table tops, as well as sliding around. This item ships in 1 carton. Please note that this item is for decorative use only. Iron sculpture makes a great gift for any occasion. Suitable for indoor use only. This is a single sculpture. Vintage style.

details.Care instructions: Wipe Clean with a Damp Cloth
